verdict.rationale: Sketch's own docs say managers and stakeholders can view, inspect and comment on work in the web app, and that comments can be added from iPhone or iPad. That covers the core of in-file review, but nothing in the evidence documents @-mentioning teammates or resolving comment threads. Missing for 10: documented @mentions of teammates, documented thread resolution, comment notifications or workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of the commenting experience.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: Developers, managers, and stakeholders can view, inspect, and comment on your work
you can use your iPhone or iPad to browse your Workspace, view documents and prototypes, add comments
